237:t_000:40.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Disclosing $$人類銀河同盟$$ information number X12030702.」

237:t_000:41.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The center of the galaxy is presumed to contain the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ home base.」

237:t_000:42.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「At the same time, several other species hostile to humanity have been confirmed to inhabit it, and for the Alliance the galactic center is the ultimate strategic attack objective.」

237:t_000:43.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ nest...」

237:t_000:45.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That most likely means the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

237:t_000:46.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, bring up information on the species hostile to humanity other than the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

237:t_000:47.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Direct combat with them was not anticipated for this unit's assigned force, so no detailed information on them is recorded.」

237:t_000:49.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Maybe the reason the main force of the $$サイデリアル$$ is deployed toward the galactic core is to exterminate them.」

237:t_000:50.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Species hostile to humanity... The so-called $$バアル$$, then...」

237:t_000:51.en:
$$オットー$$
「Are the $$サイデリアル$$ trying to use $$地球の次元力$$ to exterminate the $$バアル$$...!」

237:t_000:52.en:
$$レイアム$$
「...Depending on how you look at it, that could also be seen as being for the sake of the entire universe.」

237:t_000:54.en:
$$ブライト$$
「XO $$レイアム$$ is right. Remember the records left in the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins.」

237:t_000:55.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...To erase the force that seeks to exist, the force that seeks to vanish tries to erase the power of life...」

237:t_000:56.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「And that is what gives birth to the $$バアル$$...」

237:t_000:57.en:
$$ブライト$$
「In other words, it must mean that if we can defeat the $$バアル$$, the universe's rebirth... its collapse... won't happen.」

237:t_000:58.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Then again, once we've been destroyed by the $$バアル$$, you could say it makes no difference whether the universe collapses or whatever else happens.」

237:t_000:59.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ must know that fact...」

237:t_000:60.en:
$$オットー$$
「I understand it in theory, but that doesn't mean I can bring myself to bow to invaders.」

237:t_000:61.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...It's a shame. If they had acknowledged us as fellow beings living in the universe together, we could have cooperated with them in the fight against the $$バアル$$...」

237:t_000:62.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...When we were flung to the galactic core, I wondered what would become of us, but we've managed to obtain all sorts of information in ways we never imagined.」

237:t_000:63.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All that's left is how to bring this back to Earth...」

237:t_000:64.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「While we were at the galactic core, I thought we could get back given enough time, but in our present situation, where we don't even know which world this is...」

237:t_000:65.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Be careful! I've detected a distortion in the dimensional boundary line!」

237:t_000:66.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Something is transferring into this space!」

237:t_001:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, prepare to sortie! We don't know what's coming, so don't let your guard down!」

237:t_002:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「$$バジュラ$$ and Hideauze! There are $$宇宙怪獣$$ and Invaders too!」

237:t_002:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「It's every last one of the so-called hostile species, all here at once!」

237:t_002:2.en:
$$キャシー$$
「There's no sign of coordination between the factions, but they appear to be targeting us!」

237:t_002:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They intend to drive out us who set foot in their territory...!」

237:t_002:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Intercept them! All units, sortie!」

237:t_003:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$カミーユ$$, $$ガロード$$ and the others went through the same thing I did, so I can't write it off as a dream or a vision...)

237:t_003:3.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Stop spacing out, $$アマタ$$. The enemy is almost on top of us!」

237:t_003:4.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm fine, $$カイエン$$. I can do this... I have to.」

237:t_003:5.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What...? Far from spacing out, you're totally fired up.」

237:t_003:7.en:
$$アマタ$$
(Something inside me is telling me... this place... is dangerous...)

237:t_003:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units! Since we don't know where we are, avoid unnecessary losses as much as possible!」

237:t_003:10.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Especially, assume that damage to the warships would be fatal! All units, protect the ships and hit the enemies that approach!」

237:t_004:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! What's wrong with $n?」

237:t_004:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's nothing serious. I'm having them join the battle as is.」

237:t_004:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We're doing this, $n. Wherever we are, we have to carve out our own path by our own strength...!」

237:t_005:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, begin the attack! We will return to Earth, no matter what!」

237:t_006:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Looks like we got through that somehow...」

237:t_006:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But if we keep getting attacked by things like that, again and again...」

237:t_007:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What!? The enemy just got taken out of nowhere!」

237:t_009:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Since there are $$アンゲロイ$$-types among them, we should regard them as $$サイデリアル$$ forces.」

237:t_009:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This is different from the last battle... When I look at them...」

237:t_009:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「I feel my will to fight withering away...」

237:t_009:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No. It's awe at overwhelming power.」

237:t_009:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When a small child has met an adult's anger, they do everything they can to beg forgiveness.」

237:t_009:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It isn't defiance or resistance. They apologize and fawn, just to wait out the anger, and lay their own helplessness bare.」

237:t_009:12.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Are we... going to end... here...」
